# Exact M42 cross-gap fourth nonsimplicial witness-cell continuation

## Literal verdict

**NONWINNER.** No strict own-centroid `(S,U,H)=(1,1,0)` homogeneous convex polyhedron was obtained. The strongest materialized object is an exact rational, uniformly dense, own-centred open endpoint with strict class **`(2,2,2)`**. This is an exact negative result for the endpoint, its positive coordinate box, and the first eight adjacent two-control chambers—not a global obstruction to every larger M42 topology.

The new operation is genuinely beyond the three-cell parent. It absorbs rows `{130,153,154,176,182,201,220,221,222}`, so the parent obstruction edge `(153,154)`, stable face `[201,220,221]`, and saddle edges `(130,222)` and `(176,182)` all disappear as actual incidence. Six macroscopic replacement rows `223..228` make a triangular-prismatic closure with four linked triangular-bipyramidal centroid-fan cells. The central true edge `(223,224)` has angle `12.176168280690863°`, replacing the parent’s `53.18645752675954°` dominant angular gap. Protected vertex `8` remains the unique farthest actual vertex. The residual Euler-neutral block transfers to stable face `[195,224,223]`, unstable vertex `227`, saddles `(135,224)` and `(183,223)`, and the exact external-positive true edge `(226,227)`.

## Positive coordinate box

Rows `0..16` and all inactive inputs are fixed. Every coordinate of the other active rows—`198` independent coordinates—may vary by `±1/1000000000000`. Exact outward rational intervals preserve the full `(83, 229, 148)` hull, strict `(2, 2, 2)`, all parent-feature deletions, unique-farthest target, all four nonsimplicial cells, the `(226,227)` obstruction, and the two-component acute-graph obstruction.

## Search attempts and falsification

The 20-parameter macroscopic prism/projective/metric family was searched by differential evolution, followed by four local feature-targeted continuations and fixed-geometry mechanical-centre tests. Competitive states included `(2,3,3)`, `(3,2,3)`, and `(3,3,4)`, but no open `(1,1,0)` state appeared. These searches are empirical guidance only. The exact nonwinner result rests on the exhaustive endpoint audit, positive box, exact chamber atlas, edge identity, and acute-component theorem.

## Independent verification and mesh

The standard-library clean-room verifier independently enumerates every supporting plane from all unique input triples, proves the complete 148-face hull, reconstructs all 229 true edges and the connected Euler-2 boundary, recomputes exact mass/centroid/zero moments, audits all 148 faces, 83 vertices and 229 four-component edge cones, checks all deleted parent features, the four-cell complex, exact obstruction, unique-farthest target, and the two acute components. The separate interval, chamber-atlas, graph, and mesh verifiers all pass.

The matching OBJ/STL have `83` vertices, `162` triangles, `243` triangulated mesh edges, and Euler number `2`. Fourteen mesh-only edges triangulate the protected 17-gon. Recomputed decimal volume is `95.03325164350123`; the mesh centre-of-mass norm is `7.883978793478446e-15`. `RUN_ALL_VERIFIERS.txt` ends with `ALL VERIFIERS PASS`.

## Sharpest genuinely new successor

Another scalar endpoint transfer, local cap, serial rail, fixed-ray radial regrading, or same-component metric polish is subsumed. The current failure is not radial order—target `8` is already uniquely farthest—but an exact **acute-component separation**: the terminal obstruction component and target component are separated by negative dot products for every cross pair.

The smallest topology not represented is therefore an **acute-component-merging fifth nonsimplicial cell** (or a pair of edge-sharing prismatic/octahedral cells) that rotates or inserts at least one macroscopic ray direction so the actual true-edge graph gains a positive-dot bridge between the two exact components. It must simultaneously absorb the residual packet `{135,183,195,223,224,226,227}`, delete `(226,227)`, replace stable `[195,224,223]` and saddles `(135,224),(183,223)`, preserve the 17-gon and unique-farthest vertex `8`, and include a genuine finite-thickness terminal-to-target route. With the endpoint rays/radii fixed, at least 19 witness edges are necessary; a macroscopic ray rotation can beat that count. At least two noncritical return-lobe actuators and the three exact dependent ordinary-moment coordinates should remain available, with a full hull/full-cone rebuild at every incidence wall.
